title: Fixed SQLite automation timestamps
summary: Architecture: the trigger writes a future step and the poller selects only steps whose time has arrived. Problem: SQLite sorts numeric timestamps before text timestamps, so a future step can appear due. Solution: write and compare the same UTC text timestamp format, and convert already stored numeric dates before polling.
validation: Private experimental automations; SQLite-specific behavior. Proposed patch preserves milliseconds and leaves MySQL date bindings unchanged. No test or migration execution claim.
